system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT00658515 ()
Title: A Study of RO4607381 in Stable Coronary Heart Disease Patients With Recent Acute Coronary Syndrome
Official title: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study Assessing the Effect of RO4607381 on Cardiovascular Mortality and Morbidity in Clinically Stable Patients With a Recent Acute Coronary Syndrome
Sponsor: Hoffmann-La Roche
Phase: PHASE3
Conditions: Coronary Heart Disease
Interventions: Dalcetrapib (RO4607381) (DRUG); Evidence-based medical care for Acute Coronary Syndrome (DRUG); Placebo (DRUG)
Start date: 2008-04
Enrollment: 15871 (ACTUAL)
Primary outcome(s): Incidence of Cardiovascular Mortality and Morbidity [From date of randomization to first event up to 48 months]
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adult patients, \>=45 years of age;
* recently hospitalized for ACS;
* clinically stable;
* receiving evidence-based medical and dietary management of dyslipidemia.

Exclusion Criteria:

* uncontrolled diabetes;
* clinically unstable;
* severe anemia;
* uncontrolled hypertension;
* concomitant treatment with any other drug raising HDL-C (eg niacin, fibrates).
Brief summary: This study will evaluate the potential of RO4607381 to reduce cardiovascular morbidity and mortality in stable coronary heart disease patients with recent Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS) and evaluate the long term safety profile of the drug. Eligible patients in stable condition will be randomized to receive either RO4607381 600mg po or placebo po, daily, together with a background of standard medication for ACS (including aspirin, antihypertensives and statins). The anticipated time on study treatment is 2+ years, and the target sample size is 15,600 individuals.
--- END ---
